cohort: The cohort consisted of 2931 pregnant women from whom serum samples were collected in both the first and second trimesters of pregnancy.
finding: Maternal TPOAb positivity in the first and second trimesters was associated with a shorter duration of gestation and a higher risk of early term birth, with second trimester TPOAb positivity also linked to an increased risk of premature birth.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth was obtained from delivery records, and outcomes included premature birth (<37 weeks) and early term birth (37 weeks 0 days to 38 weeks 6 days).
